facts: About 516,000 people (2024), the seventh-largest city in Morocco
On the Atlantic coast, at the mouth of the Bou Regreg river
worth_knowing: The name comes from the Arabic ribat, an Islamic base or fortification. Rabat became the capital when Morocco gained independence in 1956.
